label: School quality score (0-100)
source: In-house composite of KHDA inspection ratings, school density, curricula choice and fees
provenance: NOT a third-party score, and NOT based on test scores, graduation rates or parent reviews -- Dubai publishes DSIB inspection ratings instead.
limitation: Only communities that contain a school are scored -- a community with none is null, not zero, and families there may still be well served by schools next door. Fees are inverted, treating cheaper as better, which is a value judgement, not a quality measure.
method: Each component is percentile-ranked across the communities that have it (inverted components ranked so that "better" is always higher). The score is the unweighted mean of the available percentiles. Communities with fewer than 2 components are null.
